style.name: Grunge
style.description: Style Atlas daily pick: Grunge for global-news posters, using distressed paper, scraped ink, rough halftones, torn layers and dirty black, rust-red and bone-white tones. Facts, data, scenes and information graphics dominate; Xiazi and Doudou stay small at the edges.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 八个信号把制裁、跨境电商、国防AI、独立经营、平台合规、城市安全、选举与文物返还连成一张风险图
zh-CN.headlineView: 经营者今天要同时校准交易对象、数据边界、平台责任和现场预案
zh-CN.headlineFull: 八个信号把制裁、跨境电商、国防AI、独立经营、平台合规、城市安全、选举与文物返还连成一张风险图；经营者今天要同时校准交易对象、数据边界、平台责任和现场预案
zh-CN.intro: 美国扩大对伊朗关联交易的二级制裁风险，韩国跨境电商登记与英乌AI合作改变合规和技术边界；新西兰社媒法案、几内亚垃圾场滑坡、哈萨克斯坦选举和埃及文物返还补齐公共治理信号。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 热点真正改变的不是情绪，而是下一张清单里的责任人。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先查交易对象和关键流程，再决定今天改什么。

en-US.headlineFact: Eight signals connect sanctions, cross-border commerce, defence AI, solo business, platform rules, urban safety, elections and cultural return
en-US.headlineView: operators need to recalibrate counterparties, data boundaries, platform duties and emergency plans
en-US.headlineFull: Eight signals connect sanctions, cross-border commerce, defence AI, solo business, platform rules, urban safety, elections and cultural return; operators need to recalibrate counterparties, data boundaries, platform duties and emergency plans
en-US.intro: The United States expanded secondary-sanctions risk around Iran-related activity, while South Korean e-commerce registration and a UK-Ukraine AI partnership shift compliance and technology boundaries; New Zealand online-safety rules, a Guinea landfill collapse, Kazakhstan's election and Egyptian artifact returns complete the governance map.
en-US.xiaziQuote: News changes more than mood; it changes who owns the next checklist.
en-US.doudouQuote: Check counterparties and critical workflows before choosing today's fix.

sources.title: U.S. Treasury launches Operation Economic Outcast against Iran-linked activity
Joint Declaration of Intent on a UK-Ukraine Artificial Intelligence Partnership

zh-CN.headlineFact: 韩国要求跨境电商企业登记专用识别号，物流商已发布申报提醒
zh-CN.headlineView: 卖家要让主体登记、订单资料、承运申报与退件信息使用同一套身份数据
zh-CN.headlineFull: 韩国要求跨境电商企业登记专用识别号，物流商已发布申报提醒；卖家要让主体登记、订单资料、承运申报与退件信息使用同一套身份数据
zh-CN.intro: FedEx于8月17日发布韩国监管提醒，跨境电商企业识别号成为清关资料链中的关键字段；面向韩国市场的卖家应核对登记主体、平台店铺、运单与报关委托的一致性。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 跨境增长先经过身份一致性，再经过广告转化率。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 抽查十票订单，看看四个系统里的主体名称是否相同。

en-US.headlineFact: South Korea requires a dedicated business identification number for cross-border e-commerce operators
en-US.headlineView: seller registration, order records, carrier declarations and returns need one consistent identity layer
en-US.headlineFull: South Korea requires a dedicated business identification number for cross-border e-commerce operators; seller registration, order records, carrier declarations and returns need one consistent identity layer
en-US.intro: A FedEx regulatory alert posted on August 17 flags the identification number as a key customs-data field; sellers serving South Korea should reconcile the registered entity across marketplaces, waybills and customs authorisations.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Cross-border growth passes identity consistency before ad conversion.
en-US.doudouQuote: Audit ten orders and compare the entity name across four systems.

sources.title: Regulatory alert: South Korea mandatory registration of cross-border e-commerce business identification number

zh-CN.headlineFact: 英国与乌克兰签署国防AI合作意向，建立政府、产业和学术三条协作支柱
zh-CN.headlineView: 高风险AI合作必须把主权数据、知识产权、出口管制与系统保证同步设计
zh-CN.headlineFull: 英国与乌克兰签署国防AI合作意向，建立政府、产业和学术三条协作支柱；高风险AI合作必须把主权数据、知识产权、出口管制与系统保证同步设计
zh-CN.intro: 双方计划围绕共研模型、安全数据与算力通道、联合保证、自治系统和合成数据推进试点，并强调北约互操作性；这说明AI项目的价值与治理边界正在同一份协议里被定义。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 越接近真实行动的AI，越不能把治理留到部署以后。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先写清数据归属、停止条件和谁能批准上线。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: The UK and Ukraine signed a defence-AI partnership built on government, industry and academic collaboration
en-US.headlineView: high-risk AI programs need sovereignty, IP, export controls and assurance designed together
en-US.headlineFull: The UK and Ukraine signed a defence-AI partnership built on government, industry and academic collaboration; high-risk AI programs need sovereignty, IP, export controls and assurance designed together
en-US.intro: The partners plan pilots spanning co-developed models, secure data and compute pathways, joint assurance, autonomy and synthetic data, with NATO interoperability in scope; capability and governance are being defined in the same framework.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The closer AI gets to real action, the less governance can wait until deployment.
en-US.doudouQuote: Define data ownership, stop conditions and launch authority first.

sources.title: Joint Declaration of Intent on a UK-Ukraine Artificial Intelligence Partnership

zh-CN.headlineFact: 英国统计局开始用Xero月度数据观察小企业销售与就业变化
zh-CN.headlineView: 独立经营者应把现金到账、复购和交付小时做成比宏观叙事更快的经营仪表盘
zh-CN.headlineFull: 英国统计局开始用Xero月度数据观察小企业销售与就业变化；独立经营者应把现金到账、复购和交付小时做成比宏观叙事更快的经营仪表盘
zh-CN.intro: 该实验性官方数据集按月追踪小企业销售与岗位变化，并按季度更新；对一人公司而言，最有用的对应动作是建立同频指标，避免只用关注量或总营收判断业务健康。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 小生意的领先指标，往往藏在到账速度和交付负荷里。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 每周只盯三项：现金、复购、每单小时。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: The UK statistics office is using monthly Xero data to track small-business sales and jobs
en-US.headlineView: solo operators need a faster dashboard for cash received, repeat purchase and delivery hours
en-US.headlineFull: The UK statistics office is using monthly Xero data to track small-business sales and jobs; solo operators need a faster dashboard for cash received, repeat purchase and delivery hours
en-US.intro: The experimental official dataset tracks monthly changes in small-business sales and employment with quarterly updates; one-person companies can mirror that cadence with operational measures instead of relying only on audience size or gross revenue.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A small business's leading indicators often hide in cash speed and delivery load.
en-US.doudouQuote: Track only three weekly numbers: cash, repeats and hours per order.

sources.title: Sales and jobs in small businesses

zh-CN.headlineFact: 新西兰提交网络安全法案，拟禁止16岁以下使用高风险社交平台
zh-CN.headlineView: 平台的年龄核验、儿童风险评估和报告义务正在成为产品基础设施
zh-CN.headlineFull: 新西兰提交网络安全法案，拟禁止16岁以下使用高风险社交平台；平台的年龄核验、儿童风险评估和报告义务正在成为产品基础设施
zh-CN.intro: 法案要求高风险平台采取合理年龄核验措施，并定期评估与降低儿童风险；违规企业最高可面临全球营收10%的罚款，AI陪伴平台也被纳入监管框架。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 儿童安全一旦进入法律责任，产品默认值就必须改变。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 把年龄、推荐和举报链路画成一张责任图。

en-US.headlineFact: New Zealand introduced an online-safety bill to bar under-16s from high-risk social platforms
en-US.headlineView: age assurance, child-risk assessment and reporting are becoming core product infrastructure
en-US.headlineFull: New Zealand introduced an online-safety bill to bar under-16s from high-risk social platforms; age assurance, child-risk assessment and reporting are becoming core product infrastructure
en-US.intro: The bill requires reasonable age checks and recurring assessments of risks to children; non-compliant companies could face penalties up to 10 percent of global revenue, and AI companion platforms are included in the framework.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Once child safety becomes legal responsibility, product defaults must change.
en-US.doudouQuote: Map age, recommendation and reporting as one chain of accountability.

sources.title: New Zealand moves to ban under-16s from social media
sources.publisher: Google News / New Zealand Government coverage

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国启动针对伊朗经济联系的新行动，并扩大相关交易的二级制裁风险
zh-CN.headlineView: 企业需要穿透核查客户、银行、船舶、货权与最终受益人，而不只看直接交易方
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国启动针对伊朗经济联系的新行动，并扩大相关交易的二级制裁风险；企业需要穿透核查客户、银行、船舶、货权与最终受益人，而不只看直接交易方
zh-CN.intro: 美国财政部称新行动覆盖伊朗相关石油、航运、银行和武器网络，并警告参与特定交易的外国金融机构可能被限制美元往来；贸易和支付团队应更新筛查与升级机制。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 制裁风险最危险的地方，往往在第二层关系而不是合同首页。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 为高风险订单补查银行、船舶和最终受益人。

en-US.headlineFact: The United States launched a new campaign against Iran-linked economic activity and widened secondary-sanctions risk
en-US.headlineView: companies need to screen customers, banks, vessels, title to goods and beneficial owners beyond direct counterparties
en-US.headlineFull: The United States launched a new campaign against Iran-linked economic activity and widened secondary-sanctions risk; companies need to screen customers, banks, vessels, title to goods and beneficial owners beyond direct counterparties
en-US.intro: The Treasury campaign targets Iran-linked oil, shipping, banking and weapons networks and warns that foreign financial institutions facilitating certain transactions may lose access to US correspondent accounts; trade and payments teams should update escalation rules.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Sanctions risk often sits in the second relationship, not on the contract cover.
en-US.doudouQuote: Add banks, vessels and beneficial owners to high-risk order checks.

sources.title: U.S. Treasury launches Operation Economic Outcast against Iran-linked activity

zh-CN.headlineFact: 几内亚首都垃圾场在暴雨后滑坡，造成30人死亡、至少6人重伤
zh-CN.headlineView: 高风险城市设施必须把关闭决定、居民迁移和极端天气预警连成一条执行链
zh-CN.headlineFull: 几内亚首都垃圾场在暴雨后滑坡，造成30人死亡、至少6人重伤；高风险城市设施必须把关闭决定、居民迁移和极端天气预警连成一条执行链
zh-CN.intro: 达累斯萨拉姆露天垃圾场的废弃物山体坍塌，掩埋周边棚屋并摧毁住宅；该地点原计划当天关闭，事故凸显已识别风险与实际撤离之间的执行缺口。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 风险被写进通知，不等于居民已经离开危险区。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 预案要记录谁确认、谁撤离、谁复核。

en-US.headlineFact: A rain-triggered landfill landslide in Guinea's capital killed 30 people and seriously injured at least six
en-US.headlineView: high-risk urban sites need one execution chain linking closure, relocation and extreme-weather warnings
en-US.headlineFull: A rain-triggered landfill landslide in Guinea's capital killed 30 people and seriously injured at least six; high-risk urban sites need one execution chain linking closure, relocation and extreme-weather warnings
en-US.intro: A waste mound at Conakry's Dar Es Salam dump collapsed onto nearby shelters and destroyed homes; the site had been scheduled to close that day, exposing the gap between identifying danger and completing evacuation.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A risk written in a notice does not mean people have left the danger zone.
en-US.doudouQuote: Plans must name who confirms, who evacuates and who verifies.

sources.title: Landslide at landfill in Guinea kills 30 people

zh-CN.headlineFact: 哈萨克斯坦初步结果显示执政阵营正义党在议会选举中获得约71%选票
zh-CN.headlineView: 高度集中的政治结果会影响政策连续性，也会放大机构制衡与市场准入判断
zh-CN.headlineFull: 哈萨克斯坦初步结果显示执政阵营正义党在议会选举中获得约71%选票；高度集中的政治结果会影响政策连续性，也会放大机构制衡与市场准入判断
zh-CN.intro: 中央选举委员会公布的初步结果显示，新成立的正义党取得压倒性领先；面向中亚经营的团队应同时评估政策稳定、监管集中度、伙伴选择和合规升级路径。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 稳定性和集中度常常同时上升，判断不能只看其中一面。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 把政策连续性和机构制衡分别打分。

en-US.headlineFact: Preliminary results gave Kazakhstan's pro-government Adilet party about 71 percent of the parliamentary vote
en-US.headlineView: a concentrated result can increase policy continuity while raising questions about checks and market access
en-US.headlineFull: Preliminary results gave Kazakhstan's pro-government Adilet party about 71 percent of the parliamentary vote; a concentrated result can increase policy continuity while raising questions about checks and market access
en-US.intro: The central election commission's preliminary count put the newly formed Adilet party far ahead; teams operating in Central Asia should assess policy stability, regulatory concentration, partner selection and compliance escalation together.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Stability and concentration often rise together; judging only one side is incomplete.
en-US.doudouQuote: Score policy continuity and institutional checks separately.

sources.title: Kazakhstan pro-government party wins parliamentary election

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国联邦调查局向埃及返还48件被非法贩运的古代文物
zh-CN.headlineView: 文化资产的来源链、持有记录和跨境文件正在成为机构信誉的一部分
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国联邦调查局向埃及返还48件被非法贩运的古代文物；文化资产的来源链、持有记录和跨境文件正在成为机构信誉的一部分
zh-CN.intro: 返还物包括雕像、护身符和墓葬用品，年代跨越法老、罗马与科普特时期；调查确认这些物品被非法带离埃及，事件提醒收藏、拍卖和展陈机构加强来源审查。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 文物的价值不只在年代，也在一条经得起核查的来源链。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先核对来源，再讨论价格和展览。

en-US.headlineFact: The FBI returned 48 illicitly trafficked ancient artifacts to Egypt
en-US.headlineView: provenance, custody records and cross-border documents are becoming part of institutional trust
en-US.headlineFull: The FBI returned 48 illicitly trafficked ancient artifacts to Egypt; provenance, custody records and cross-border documents are becoming part of institutional trust
en-US.intro: The returned objects include figurines, amulets and funerary material spanning Pharaonic, Roman and Coptic periods; investigators determined they had been trafficked out of Egypt, reinforcing the need for provenance checks across collecting, auctions and exhibitions.
en-US.xiaziQuote: An artifact's value lies not only in age but in a provenance chain that survives scrutiny.
en-US.doudouQuote: Verify provenance before discussing price or display.

sources.title: FBI returns 48 cultural artifacts to Egyptian government
